metadata.question: Did clouds cover a larger area within a 10 km radius of Halema‘uma‘u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano, than the volcanic plume on July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Primary: Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED), within ±1 hour of 2025-07-20 20:44 UTC (10:44 HST), over a 10 km radius around Halema‘uma‘u (lon -155.2834, lat 19.4069).
   - Fallbacks if empty: Landsat 9 L2, then Landsat 8 L2 (same ±1 hour). If still empty, widen Sentinel-2 to ±2 hours.
2. Masking strategy:
   - Clouds (S2): Scene Classification Layer SCL ∈ {7,8,9,10} (cloud low/med/high, cirrus).
   - Volcanic plume: spectral ratio Blue/SWIR2 where plume tends to be bright in blue and darker in SWIR. Use B2/B12 > 1.3 with constraints B2 > 0.04 and B12 > 0.001 and excluding SCL cloud pixels.
   - Landsat fallback: clouds via QA_PIXEL bits (cloud or cirrus); plume via Blue/SWIR2 (B2/B7) with similar thresholds on scaled reflectance.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - Check collection sizes; if all zero after recovery attempts: C1.
   - Compute valid data pixel count at 1 km; if 0: C2.
   - If area computations return null/NaN: C3.
   - Otherwise compare cloudArea > plumeArea; A if true, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lon = -155.2834;
    const lat = 19.4069;
    const center = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]);
    const region = center.buffer(10000); // 10 km
    const targetUTC = ee.Date('2025-07-20T20:44:00'); // 10:44 HST = 20:44 UTC
    const makeWindow = (hours) => {
      return {
        start: targetUTC.advance(-hours, 'hour'),
        end: targetUTC.advance(hours, 'hour'),
      };
    };
    const regionAreaKm2 = ee.Number(region.area(1)).divide(1e6);

    // 2. Helper functions
    function pickNearest(ic, targetDate) {
      return ic.map(function (img) {
        const diffMin = img.date().difference(targetDate, 'minute').abs();
        return img.set('timeDiffMin', diffMin);
      }).sort('timeDiffMin');
    }

    function analyzeS2(window) {
      const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(window.start, window.end);
      const count = s2.size();

      const sorted = pickNearest(s2, targetUTC);
      const img = ee.Image(sorted.first());

      // Masks
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const cloudMask = scl.eq(7).or(scl.eq(8)).or(scl.eq(9)).or(scl.eq(10));

      const blue = img.select('B2');
      const swir2 = img.select('B12');
      const ratio = blue.divide(swir2);
      const plumeMask = ratio.gt(1.3)
        .and(blue.gt(0.04))
        .and(swir2.gt(0.001))
        .and(cloudMask.not());

      // Valid pixel count on a common band (B2)
      const validCount = img.select('B2').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('B2');

      const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea();
      const cloudArea = areaImg.updateMask(cloudMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('area');

      const plumeArea = areaImg.updateMask(plumeMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('area');

      const out = ee.Dictionary({
        dataset: 'S2_SR',
        imgCount: count,
        imageId: img.get('system:index'),
        timeUTC: ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm'),
        timeLocal: ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).advance(-10, 'hour').format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm'),
        timeDiffMin: img.get('timeDiffMin'),
        regionAreaKm2: regionAreaKm2,
        validCount: validCount,
        cloudAreaKm2: ee.Number(cloudArea).divide(1e6),
        plumeAreaKm2: ee.Number(plumeArea).divide(1e6)
      });
      return out;
    }

    function scaleLandsatSR(img) {
      // Apply scale and offset for optical SR: reflectance = DN * 0.0000275 - 0.2
      const optical = img.select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B7']).multiply(0.0000275).subtract(0.2)
        .rename(['B2', 'B7']);
      // QA_PIXEL for clouds/cirrus
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      return img.addBands(optical, null, true).addBands(qa);
    }

    function analyzeLandsat(collectionId, window, label) {
      let ls = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(window.start, window.end)
        .map(scaleLandsatSR);
      const count = ls.size();
      const sorted = pickNearest(ls, targetUTC);
      const img = ee.Image(sorted.first());

      // Cloud mask: QA_PIXEL bits
      // Bits: 1 = Dilated Cloud, 3 = Cloud, 4 = Cloud Shadow, 2 = Cirrus (for L8/9 C2 L2)
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const cloudBit = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0); // Cloud
      const cirrusBit = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0); // Cirrus
      const cloudMask = cloudBit.or(cirrusBit);

      const blue = img.select('B2');
      const swir2 = img.select('B7');
      const ratio = blue.divide(swir2);
      const plumeMask = ratio.gt(1.3)
        .and(blue.gt(0.04))
        .and(swir2.gt(0.001))
        .and(cloudMask.not());

      const validCount = blue.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('B2');

      const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea();
      const cloudArea = areaImg.updateMask(cloudMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('area');
      const plumeArea = areaImg.updateMask(plumeMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('area');

      const out = ee.Dictionary({
        dataset: label,
        imgCount: count,
        imageId: img.get('system:index'),
        timeUTC: ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm'),
        timeLocal: ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).advance(-10, 'hour').format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm'),
        timeDiffMin: img.get('timeDiffMin'),
        regionAreaKm2: regionAreaKm2,
        validCount: validCount,
        cloudAreaKm2: ee.Number(cloudArea).divide(1e6),
        plumeAreaKm2: ee.Number(plumeArea).divide(1e6)
      });
      return out;
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Checks with fallbacks
    const window1 = makeWindow(1);
    const s2Count1 = await ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(region).filterDate(window1.start, window1.end).size().getInfo();

    let resultDict = null;
    if (s2Count1 > 0) {
      resultDict = analyzeS2(window1);
    } else {
      const l9Count1 = await ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(region).filterDate(window1.start, window1.end).size().getInfo();
      if (l9Count1 > 0) {
        resultDict = analyzeLandsat('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2', window1, 'L9_SR');
      } else {
        const l8Count1 = await ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
          .filterBounds(region).filterDate(window1.start, window1.end).size().getInfo();
        if (l8Count1 > 0) {
          resultDict = analyzeLandsat('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', window1, 'L8_SR');
        } else {
          // Widen time window for Sentinel-2 (±2 hours) to recover
          const window2 = makeWindow(2);
          const s2Count2 = await ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
            .filterBounds(region).filterDate(window2.start, window2.end).size().getInfo();
          if (s2Count2 > 0) {
            resultDict = analyzeS2(window2);
          } else {
            console.log('S2 Images: 0 (±1h, ±2h), L9: 0, L8: 0');
            console.log('Region km²:', (await regionAreaKm2.getInfo()).toFixed(2));
            console.log('C1');
            return;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Calculation & Retrieval
    const out = await ee.Dictionary(resultDict).getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const validCount = out.validCount;
    const cloudAreaKm2 = out.cloudAreaKm2;
    const plumeAreaKm2 = out.plumeAreaKm2;

    if (validCount === null || cloudAreaKm2 === null || plumeAreaKm2 === null) {
      console.log('Calculation returned null.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (!isFinite(validCount) || !isFinite(cloudAreaKm2) || !isFinite(plumeAreaKm2)) {
      console.log('Calculation invalid (NaN/Inf).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (validCount === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const regionKm2 = out.regionAreaKm2;
    const cloudPct = (cloudAreaKm2 / regionKm2) * 100.0;
    const plumePct = (plumeAreaKm2 / regionKm2) * 100.0;

    // Concise Evidence (<=20 lines)
    console.log('Target UTC: 2025-07-20 20:44, Radius: 10 km, Region km²:', regionKm2.toFixed(2));
    console.log(`Dataset: ${out.dataset}, Images: ${out.imgCount}, Chosen: ${out.imageId}`);
    console.log(`Acq UTC: ${out.timeUTC}, Local (HST): ${out.timeLocal}, Δt(min): ${Number(out.timeDiffMin).toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log('Valid px (1 km):', validCount);
    console.log('Cloud area km² (%):', cloudAreaKm2.toFixed(2), `(${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log('Plume area km² (%):', plumeAreaKm2.toFixed(2), `(${plumePct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    const cloudsLarger = cloudAreaKm2 > plumeAreaKm2;
    console.log('Clouds larger than plume?', cloudsLarger ? 'Yes' : 'No');

    // Final answer tag
    console.log(cloudsLarger ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
